werden und samptlich vor erhaltung der kirchen Gottes und rechter lere, darzu der treuen
warhaftigen lerer und das Gott treue arbeiter in seine ernte senden wolle, für die oberkeit, für
zeitlichen friede und gewechs der früchte und in summa für die not der ganzen christenheit und
sonderbarer personen, die des christlichen gebets begeren, wie des ungefehrlich eine notel
folget.

**Rubric (English).** Thereupon the people shall again be exhorted to prayer and thanksgiving
toward God, and all together for the preservation of the Church of God and of right doctrine,
and moreover of the faithful, true teachers, and that God would send faithful labourers into his
harvest; for the magistrates, for temporal peace and the growth of the fruits; and in sum for
the need of the whole of Christendom and of particular persons that desire the Christian prayer;
whereof a draft followeth, after this manner.

**Bid (German).** Lieben Christen, last uns Gott bitten, das er uns bey seinem göttlichen wort
wolle gnediglich erhalten und getreue arbeiter in seine ernte senden, den predigern und
kirchendienern seinen heiligen Geist verleihen, das sie dasselbige rein und recht fürtragen und
leren, auch mit gottseligem leben fürgehen und das der allmechtige wolle sie und uns vor
falscher lere gnediglich behüten und derselbigen steuren und wehren. Das er auch unsern brüdern
und schwestern, die mit falscher lere oder sonst mit unrechter gewalt von unchristen oder andern
tyrannen angefochten und beschwert werden, gnediglich helfen wolle, das sie in warem glauben und
gedult bestendig bleiben, und so möglich, die verfolgung von ihnen genomen oder gemiltert werde.

**Bid (English).** Dear Christians, let us pray God that he would graciously keep us in his
divine word, and send faithful labourers into his harvest; vouchsafe his Holy Spirit unto the
preachers and ministers of the Church, that they may set forth and teach the same purely and
rightly, and also go before with godly life; and that the Almighty would graciously keep them
and us from false doctrine, and restrain and withstand the same. That he would also graciously
help our brethren and sisters which are assailed and oppressed with false doctrine or else with
unrighteous violence by unchristian men or other tyrants, that they may abide steadfast in true
faith and patience, and, if it be possible, that the persecution may be taken from them or
mitigated.

#### <a id="s6-14-j-2"></a>J.2 Civil authority

*Witnesses:* Lüneburg 1564, Braunschweig-Wolfenbüttel 1569 and Oldenburg 1573.

**Bid (German).** Bittet auch vor weltliche oberkeiten, keyserliche majestät und andere
potentaten, auch alle andere, die im ampt der oberkeit sitzen, das der allmechtige wolle
diejenige, die durch Gottes wort erleuchtet sein, darbey gnediglich erhalten, denen aber, so
noch nicht erleuchtet, seine gnade geben, das sie Gottes wort in ihren landen leiden und
annemen. Welche aber das nicht thun wollen und es verfolgen, das er denselbigen steuren und ihr
fürnemen schanden machen wolle.

**Bid (English).** Pray ye also for the temporal magistrates, the Imperial Majesty and other
potentates, and all others that sit in the office of magistracy: that the Almighty would
graciously keep therein them that are enlightened by God’s word, but give his grace unto them
that are not yet enlightened, that they may suffer and receive God’s word in their lands; but
that he would restrain them that will not do so and persecute it, and bring their purpose to
shame.

#### <a id="s6-14-j-3"></a>J.3 Thanksgiving

*Witnesses:* Lüneburg 1564, Braunschweig-Wolfenbüttel 1569 and Oldenburg 1573.

**Bid (German).** Sonderlich danket Gott, das er unsere gnedige landsfürsten und herrn also
begnadet hat, das sie Gottes wort lieb haben und in ihrem land predigen lassen und fördern, und
bittet, das sie der allmechtige darbey wolle gnediglich erhalten und derselben gottselig langes
leben, gesundheit und gnad verleihen, das sie ihr regiment also füren, das es Gott zu ehren und
ihren fürstlichen gnaden und derselbigen unterthanen zu gutem gereiche, und wir ein still
friedlich leben in aller gottseligkeit unter ihnen füren mögen.

**Bid (English).** Especially give thanks to God that he hath so graced our gracious princes and
lords of the land that they love God’s word and let it be preached and further it in their land;
and pray that the Almighty would graciously keep them therein and vouchsafe him godly long life,
health and grace, that they may so lead their government that it may redound to the honour of
God and to the good of their princely Graces and their subjects, and that we may lead a quiet,
peaceable life under them in all godliness.

#### <a id="s6-14-j-4"></a>J.4 Civil authority

*Witnesses:* Lüneburg 1564, Braunschweig-Wolfenbüttel 1569 and Oldenburg 1573.

**Bid (German).** Bittet auch vor unsere gnedige landsfürstin, das sie der allmechtig auch in
seinem gnedigen schutz haben und sie vor allem unheil behüten und an leib und seel segnen wolle.
Bittet auch vor die rethe, ampt und befelhaber, auch den radt dieser stadt, das ihnen Gott wolle
gnade geben, das sie wol raten und ihren befohlenen ampten und befehlichen getreulichen
fürstehen und ausrichten.

**Bid (English).** Pray ye also for our gracious princess of the land, that the Almighty would
have her also in his gracious protection, guard her from all mischief, and bless her in body and
soul. Pray ye also for the counsellors, officers and governors, and also the council of this
town, that God would give them grace to counsel well and faithfully to preside over and perform
the offices and charges committed unto them.

#### <a id="s6-14-j-5"></a>J.5 The afflicted

*Witnesses:* Lüneburg 1564, Braunschweig-Wolfenbüttel 1569 and Oldenburg 1573.

**Bid (German).** Bittet auch vor alle angefochten und betrübte herzen, vor alle kranken,
schwangere frauen, junge kinder und alle, so in nöten sein, das der allmechtige wolle
dieselbigen alle trösten, behüten und ihnen in ihren nöten beystehen und zu hülf komen.

**Bid (English).** Pray ye also for all tempted and sorrowful hearts, for all the sick, women
with child, young children, and all that are in need, that the Almighty would comfort and guard
them all, and stand by them and come to their help in their needs.

#### <a id="s6-14-j-6"></a>J.6 Deliverance from calamities

*Witnesses:* Lüneburg 1564, Braunschweig-Wolfenbüttel 1569 and Oldenburg 1573.

**Bid (German).** Bittet vor uns alle in dieser gemein und in dem ganzen lande, das Gott uns
wolle gnedig sein und behüten vor krieg, pestilenz und teuer zeit, vor feuer und wassersnot, vor
hagel und ungewitter und vor allem unglücke und ubel und wolle die früchte auf dem felde
behüten, segen und gnade geben, das wir sie mit fried, gesundheit und danksagung geniessen
mögen.

**Bid (English).** Pray ye for us all in this congregation and in the whole land, that God would
be gracious unto us and keep us from war, pestilence and dearth, from fire and flood, from hail
and tempest, and from all mischance and evil; and that he would guard the fruits upon the field
and give blessing and grace, that we may enjoy them with peace, health and thanksgiving.

#### <a id="s6-14-j-7"></a>J.7 Lord's Prayer

*Witnesses:* Lüneburg 1564, Braunschweig-Wolfenbüttel 1569 and Oldenburg 1573.

**Bid (German).** Ein jeder trage Gott seine eigen not für und betet in dem namen Christi auf
seine zusagung, da er spricht: Alles, was ihr bittet in meinem namen, gleubet, so werdet ihr es
haben, und sprecht von grund des herzens: Vater unser etc.

**Bid (English).** Let every one lay his own need before God, and pray ye in the name of Christ
upon his promise, where he saith: Whatsoever ye ask in my name, believe, and ye shall have it;
and say from the ground of the heart: Our Father, etc.

#### <a id="s6-14-j-8"></a>J.8 Special intercessions

*Witnesses:* Lüneburg 1564, Braunschweig-Wolfenbüttel 1569 and Oldenburg 1573.

**Rubric (German).** Wenn denn etwas fürfellet, davon sonderliche bit zu thun ist, als vor
sonderliche kranken, vor frauen, die in kindesnöten sein, und was sonst vor not und sachen des
landes oder sonderer personen fürfallen, das sol diesem gemeinem gebet auch mit kurzen worten
angehangen werden.

**Rubric (English).** If then aught befall whereof special petition is to be made, as for
particular sick persons, for women that are in the pains of childbirth, and whatsoever else of
need and matters of the land or of particular persons may befall, that shall be added to this
common prayer also in short words.

---

### <a id="s6-15"></a>6.15 Family K: Three collects from the pulpit

After an exhortation the minister reads three collects from the pulpit: thanksgiving or the
Church, the magistrates, and a special need, chosen from a bank.

- **Earliest witness (archetype):** Worms 1560.
- **Tradition:** Lutheran.
- **Language:** German.
- **Form:** exhortation + three collects.
- **Place in the service (Worms 1560):** On Sundays and feasts, when the choir has finished the
  first psalm or hymn, the minister goes into the pulpit, exhorts the people to prayer and reads
  three collects: (1) a thanksgiving for God’s gifts or a prayer for the preservation of the
  Church and God’s word (on feasts, a thanksgiving for the feast), (2) for the magistrates, (3) a
  special prayer as the time requires (peace, protection, fruits of the earth, rain …).

| Year | Witness | Territory | Sehling | Form |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 1560 | Worms, Agendbüchlein 1560 | Worms (Imperial city) | Sehling 19, III/4, pp. 178–183 | exhortation + three collects |

Worms reads three collects from the pulpit: a thanksgiving, or a prayer for the Church and God's
word; one for the magistrates; and a third that varies with the time, chosen from the collect
bank that follows in the order. K.2 and K.3 are the two texts for the first collect, K.4 is the
collect for the magistrates, and K.5 is the rubric for the third.

**Sequence:** K.1 Exhortation / preface > K.2 Thanksgiving > K.3 The Church > K.4 Civil
authority > K.5 Special intercessions.

#### <a id="s6-15-k-1"></a>K.1 Exhortation / preface

**Rubric (German).** VI. Vom gemeinen Gebett. Wiewol zu ende aller Predigten das Volck ernstlich
und vleissig für alle noth und anligen der gantzen Christenheit im Geistlichen, Weltlichen und
Haußregiment zubitten, Auch zur danckbarkeit gegen Gott für seine grosse und manigfältige
wolthaten genugsam ermahnet wirdt, Jedoch so werden umb mehrer erinnerung willen auch etliche
andere gemeine Gebett und Collecten gehalten und dem Volck deutlich fürgelesen inn volgender
ordnung. Am Sontag und Feiertagen, wann der Chor den ersten Psalm oder Geistlichen Gesang
vollendet hat, so gehet der Kirchendiener auff die Cantzel und ermahnet das Volck zum Gebett und
liset ihnen je auff einmal drey Collecten für. Die erste ist entzweder ein gemeine dancksagung
für allerley Gottes gaben oder ein gebett umb erhaltung der Kirchen und Göttlichs Worts oder, so
es an sonderlichen Festen ist, eine dancksagung für dieselbigen sonderen gaben, darvon man auff
dasselbige Fest pfleget zu handeln. Die ander von Weltlicher Oberkeit. Die dritt ist Specialis
und nach gelegenheit der zeit, eintzweder umb fried oder umb schutz oder für die früchte der
Erden oder für regen etc. und was dergleichen für sonderbare noth und anligen mehr fürfallen,
davon man die Christliche Kirch erinnern muß, auß nachgehender verzeichnuß.

**Rubric (English).** VI. Of the common prayer. Although at the end of all sermons the people
are sufficiently exhorted to pray earnestly and diligently for all the need and concerns of the
whole of Christendom in the spiritual, temporal and household government, and also to
thankfulness toward God for his great and manifold benefits, yet for the sake of greater
remembrance certain other common prayers and collects are also held and read plainly to the
people in the following order. On Sundays and feast days, when the choir hath finished the first
psalm or spiritual song, the minister goeth into the pulpit and exhorteth the people to prayer,
and readeth to them three collects at a time. The first is either a common thanksgiving for all
manner of God’s gifts, or a prayer for the preservation of the Church and God’s word, or, if it
be on special feasts, a thanksgiving for those special gifts whereof it is wont to be treated on
that feast. The second is of the temporal magistrates. The third is special, according to the
occasion of the time: either for peace, or for protection, or for the fruits of the earth, or
for rain, etc., and whatsoever like special need and concern may befall, whereof the Christian
Church must be put in mind, out of the register following.

#### <a id="s6-15-k-2"></a>K.2 Thanksgiving

**Rubric (German).** Ein gemeine dancksagung für allerley wolthaten Gottes.

**Rubric (English).** A common thanksgiving for all manner of benefits of God.

**Prayer (German).** Allmechtiger Herr Gott, Himlischer Vatter, von dem wir on unterlaß allerley
gutes gantz uberflüssig entpfahen und teglich vor allem ubel stattlich und gnediglich behütet
werden, Wir bitten Dich, gib uns durch Deinen Geist, solches alles mit gantzem hertzen inn
rechtem Glauben zu erkennen, auff das wir Deiner milten güte und Barmhertzigkeit hie und dort
Ewigklich dancken und Dich loben, Durch unsern Herrn Jhesum Christum, Deinen lieben Son etc.

**Prayer (English).** Almighty Lord God, heavenly Father, of whom we without ceasing receive all
manner of good right abundantly, and are daily kept from all evil stately and graciously: we
beseech thee, give us by thy Spirit to acknowledge all this with our whole heart in right faith,
that we may thank thy bountiful goodness and mercy here and there eternally, and praise thee;
through our Lord Jesus Christ thy dear Son, etc.

#### <a id="s6-15-k-3"></a>K.3 The Church

**Rubric (German).** Umb erhaltung und fruchtbar gedeien Göttlichs worts.

**Rubric (English).** For the preservation and fruitful increase of God’s word.

**Prayer (German).** Allmechtiger Gott, Wir bitten Dich, gibe Deiner gemein Deinen Geist und
Göttliche Weißheit, das Dein wort unter uns lauffe und wachse und mit aller freidigkeit, wie
sichs gebüret, geprediget und Dein Heilige Christliche gemein dardurch gebessert werde, auff das
wir mit bestendigem glauben Dir dienen und inn bekandtnuß Deines namens biß ans ende verharren,
Durch unsern Herren etc.

**Prayer (English).** Almighty God, we beseech thee, give unto thy congregation thy Spirit and
divine wisdom, that thy word may run and grow among us and be preached with all boldness, as it
becometh, and that thy holy Christian congregation may be bettered thereby; that we may serve
thee with steadfast faith and continue in the confession of thy name unto the end; through our
Lord, etc.

#### <a id="s6-15-k-4"></a>K.4 Civil authority

**Rubric (German).** Für Weltliche Obrigkeit allein.

**Rubric (English).** For the temporal magistrates alone.

**Prayer (German).** O Barmhertziger Himlischer Vatter, inn welches handt bestehet aller
menschen gewalt und wolfart der frommen, inn welches handt auch stehen alle Recht und Gesetz
aller Reich auff Erden, Wir bitten Dich, sihe gnedigklich auff Deine Diener, den Römischen
Keyser, alle König, Fürsten und Christliche Obrigkeit, damit sie das Weltliche schwerdt, ihnen
von Dir befohlen, nach Deinem befehl führen mögen, Erleuchte und erhalte sie bey Deinem
Göttlichen namen, gibe ihnen, lieber Herr, Weißheit und verstandt und ein friedlich Regiment,
auff das sie ihre Unterthanen inn fried, rhue und einigkeit beschirmen und regieren, Erlengere
ihnen, O Gott unsers Heils, ire tag, auff das wir, unter ihrer Herrschaft, Deinen Göttlichen
namen, sampt ihnen, heiligen und preisen mögen, Durch unsern Herrn Jhesum Christum etc.

**Prayer (English).** O merciful heavenly Father, in whose hand standeth all power of men and
the welfare of the godly, in whose hand also stand all the rights and laws of all realms upon
earth: we beseech thee, look graciously upon thy servants, the Roman Emperor, all kings, princes
and Christian magistrates, that they may bear the temporal sword, committed unto them of thee,
according to thy commandment. Enlighten them and keep them in thy divine name; give them, dear
Lord, wisdom and understanding and a peaceable government, that they may defend and rule their
subjects in peace, rest and unity. Prolong their days, O God of our salvation, that under their
dominion we together with them may hallow and praise thy divine name; through our Lord Jesus
Christ, etc.

#### <a id="s6-15-k-5"></a>K.5 Special intercessions

**Rubric (German).** Die dritt ist Specialis … auß nachgehender verzeichnuß.

**Rubric (English).** The third is special … out of the register following.

---

### <a id="s6-16"></a>6.16 Family L: Intercessions under the Sanctus (Brandenburg 1540)

Not a pulpit prayer but collects said by the priest in the Mass under the Sanctus, for
ministers, magistrates and peace, in the place the Roman Canon had its intercessions. Followed
by Calenberg-Göttingen 1542 and Pfalz-Neuburg 1543.

- **Earliest witness (archetype):** Brandenburg 1540.
- **Tradition:** Lutheran.
- **Language:** German.
- **Form:** collects said by the priest under the Sanctus.
- **Place in the service (Brandenburg 1540):** In the Mass, after the Preface, while the Latin
  Sanctus is sung; followed by the Verba (sung in German, with elevation) and the Our Father. The
  prayers stand where the Roman Canon had its intercessions.

| Year | Witness | Territory | Sehling | Form |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 1540 | Mark Brandenburg, Kirchenordnung (Kurfürst Joachim II.) | Electorate of Brandenburg | Sehling 3, Mark Brandenburg Nr. 3, pp. 68–69 | collects said by the priest |
| 1542 | Calenberg-Göttingen, Kirchenordnung (Herzogin Elisabeth; Corvinus) | Principality of Calenberg-Göttingen | Sehling 6/2, III/Calenberg-Göttingen, p. 815 | collect said by the priest |
| 1543 | Pfalz-Neuburg, Kirchenordnung (Pfalzgraf Ottheinrich; Osiander) | Palatinate-Neuburg | Sehling 13, I.2, p. 74 | collects said by the priest |

Each collect ends "durch deinen son Jesum Christum, amen." in place of the abbreviation "durch
unsern herrn etc." (GENERAL_PRAYERS_GUIDE.md, *Representative texts*, rule 4).

**Sequence:** L.1 Civil authority > L.2 Ministers of the Word > L.3 Peace > L.4 Repentance &
forgiveness > L.5 Lord's Prayer.

#### <a id="s6-16-l-1"></a>L.1 Civil authority

*Witnesses:* Brandenburg 1540, Calenberg-Göttingen 1542 and Pfalz-Neuburg 1543.

**Rubric (German).** Unter dem sanctus sol der priester folgende oration deudsch beten. ¶ Fur
die oberigkeit.

**Rubric (English).** Under the Sanctus the priest shall pray the following prayer in German. ¶
For the magistrates.

**Prayer (German).** Barmherziger himlischer vater, in welches hende aller menschen gewalt und
obrigkeit stehet, von dir eingesetzt zur straf der ubeltheter und zum schutz der fromen, in
welches hende auch stehen alle recht und gesetze aller lender, wir bitten dich, sei gnedig
unserm herrn kaiser, allen königen und fürsten, sonderlich unserm landesfursten und herrn N. und
dem rath und regenten dieser stadt und aller ordenlichen obrigkeit, damit sie das weltlich
schwerd, das du inen befohlen hast, recht füren mügen; umschattige sie mit der kraft des
allerhöchsten, erleucht und erhalt sie bei deinem göttlichen namen, lass sie dein göttlichs wort
von herzen lieb haben und darüber fest halten und sie ja dasselbig nicht lassen verfolgen, gib
inen, lieber herr, weisheit und einen verstand und ein fridsam regiment, auf das sie alle ire
unterthanen in der warheit und gerechtigkeit, die dir gefellig ist, regiren und beschirmen,
auch, mein lieber gott, friste inen ir leben lang, nach deinem willen und weil das gerichte dein
ist und sie an deiner stad sitzen, gib inen gnad, also zu regiren, das dein heiliger name durch
sie geheiligt und gepreiset werde, von nu an bis in ewigkeit, das helf inen der herr Jesu
Christ, dein geliebter son, amen.

**Prayer (English).** Merciful heavenly Father, in whose hands standeth all power and authority
of men, ordained of thee for the punishment of evildoers and the protection of the godly, in
whose hands also stand all the rights and laws of all lands: we beseech thee, be gracious unto
our lord the Emperor, all kings and princes, especially unto our prince and lord of the land N.,
and unto the council and rulers of this city and all lawful magistrates, that they may rightly
bear the temporal sword which thou hast committed unto them. Overshadow them with the power of
the Highest; enlighten them and keep them in thy divine name; let them love thy divine word from
the heart and hold fast thereto, and in no wise suffer it to be persecuted. Give them, dear
Lord, wisdom and understanding and a peaceable government, that they may rule and defend all
their subjects in the truth and righteousness that is well-pleasing unto thee. Also, my dear
God, prolong their life according to thy will; and forasmuch as the judgement is thine and they
sit in thy stead, give them grace so to rule that thy holy name may be hallowed and praised
through them, from henceforth even for ever. This help them the Lord Jesus Christ, thy beloved
Son. Amen.

#### <a id="s6-16-l-2"></a>L.2 Ministers of the Word

*Witnesses:* Brandenburg 1540 and Pfalz-Neuburg 1543.

**Rubric (German).** Ein ander.

**Rubric (English).** Another.

**Prayer (German).** O almechtiger gütiger gott und vater unsers herrn Jesu Christi, der du uns
ernstlich befohlen hast, das wir dich bitten sollen um arbeiter in deiner ernten, das ist um
rechtschaffne prediger deines worts. Wir bitten dein gründlose barmherzigkeit, du wollest uns
rechtschaffne lerer und diener deines göttlichen worts zuschicken und denselben dein heilsams
wort in das herz und in den mund geben, das sie deinen befelch treulich ausrichten und nichts
predigen, das deinem heiligen wort entgegen sei, auf das wir durch dein himlisch ewigs wort
ermanet, geleret, gespeist, getröst und gesterkt werden, thun, was dir gefellig und uns
fruchtbarlich ist; gib herr deiner heiligen christlichen kirchen deinen geist und göttliche
weisheit, das dein wort unter uns laufe und wachse und mit aller freidigkeit, wie sichs gebürt,
gepredigt und dein heilige christliche gemein dadurch gebessert werde, auf das wir mit
bestendigem glauben dir dienen und in erkentnis deines namens bis an das ende verharren, durch
deinen son Jesum Christum, amen.

**Prayer (English).** O almighty, gracious God and Father of our Lord Jesus Christ, who hast
earnestly commanded us that we should pray thee for labourers into thine harvest, that is, for
right and true preachers of thy word: we beseech thy bottomless mercy that thou wouldest send us
right and true teachers and ministers of thy divine word, and give thy wholesome word into their
heart and into their mouth, that they may faithfully perform thy commandment and preach nothing
that is contrary to thy holy word; to the end that we, being by thy heavenly, eternal word
admonished, taught, fed, comforted and strengthened, may do that which is well-pleasing unto
thee and profitable unto us. Give, O Lord, unto thy holy Christian Church thy Spirit and divine
wisdom, that thy word may run and grow among us and be preached with all boldness, as it
becometh, and that thy holy Christian congregation may be bettered thereby; that we may serve
thee with steadfast faith and continue in the knowledge of thy name unto the end; through thy
Son Jesus Christ. Amen.

#### <a id="s6-16-l-3"></a>L.3 Peace

*Witnesses:* Brandenburg 1540 and Pfalz-Neuburg 1543.

**Rubric (German).** Ein ander.

**Rubric (English).** Another.

**Prayer (German).** Almechtiger gott und ewiger vater, ein könig der ehren und ein herr himels
und der erden, durch welches geist alle dinge regiret, durch welches fursehung alle dinge
geordnet werden, du bist ein gott des friedes, von dem allein einigkeit zu uns komt, wir bitten
dich durch unsern herrn Jesum Christum, du wollest uns unser sunde vergeben und mit deinem
göttlichen friden und einigkeit begnaden, damit wir in forcht und zittern deinem namen dienen
und allezeit von uns gepreiset werdest, amen.

**Prayer (English).** Almighty God and everlasting Father, a King of glory and a Lord of heaven
and of earth, by whose Spirit all things are governed, by whose providence all things are
ordered; thou art a God of peace, from whom alone unity cometh unto us: we beseech thee through
our Lord Jesus Christ that thou wouldest forgive us our sins and endue us with thy divine peace
and unity, that we may serve thy name in fear and trembling, and that thou mayest be praised of
us evermore. Amen.

#### <a id="s6-16-l-4"></a>L.4 Repentance & forgiveness

*Witnesses:* Brandenburg 1540.

**Prayer (German).** Barmherziger gott und himlischer vater, des barmherzigkeit kein ende hat,
der du langmütig, gnedig und von grosser güte und treu bist und vergibst alle missethat,
ubertretung und sunde, wir haben leider gesundigt mit unsern vetern, wir haben mishandelt und
sind gottlos gewesen und dich oftmals erzürnet, dir allein haben wir gesundigt und ubel fur dir
gethan, aber herr, gedenke nicht an unsere vorige missethat, las bald dein barmherzigkeit uber
uns gross sein, denn wir sind elend worden, hilf uns gott unsers heils um der ehre willen deines
namens, erlöse uns und vergib uns unser sunde, durch deinen son Jesum Christum, amen.

**Prayer (English).** Merciful God and heavenly Father, whose mercy hath no end, who art
longsuffering, gracious and of great goodness and faithfulness, and forgivest all iniquity,
transgression and sin: we have, alas, sinned with our fathers, we have done amiss and dealt
wickedly and oftentimes provoked thee to wrath; against thee only have we sinned and done evil
in thy sight. But, Lord, remember not against us our former iniquities; let thy mercy speedily
be great upon us, for we are brought very low. Help us, O God of our salvation, for the glory of
thy name; deliver us and forgive us our sins; through thy Son Jesus Christ. Amen.

#### <a id="s6-16-l-5"></a>L.5 Lord's Prayer

*Witnesses:* Brandenburg 1540, Calenberg-Göttingen 1542 and Pfalz-Neuburg 1543.
*Calenberg-Göttingen 1542 lacks the rubric.*

**Rubric (German).** Darauf sol, wie hernach folget, das pater noster deudsch gesungen werden.

**Rubric (English).** Thereupon the Pater noster shall be sung in German, as followeth.

**Bid (German).** Last uns beten, wie uns der herr Christus Jesus befohlen hat, das wir aus
rechter zuversicht und vertrauen dorfen sagen:

**Bid (English).** Let us pray, as the Lord Christ Jesus hath commanded us, that out of right
confidence and trust we may be bold to say:

**Prayer (German).** Vater unser, der du bist im himel, geheiliget werde dein name, zukome dein
reich, dein wil geschehe als im himel auch auf erden, unser teglich brod gib uns heute und
vergib uns unser schulde als wir vergeben unsern schuldigern und für uns nicht in versuchung,
sondern erlös uns von dem ubel, denn dein ist das reich und die kraft und die herrlichkeit in
ewigkeit.

**Prayer (English).** Our Father, which art in heaven, hallowed be thy name, thy kingdom come,
thy will be done, as in heaven, so in earth; give us this day our daily bread, and forgive us
our debts, as we forgive our debtors; and lead us not into temptation, but deliver us from evil:
for thine is the kingdom, and the power, and the glory, for ever.

---

### <a id="s6-17"></a>6.17 Family M: Pulpit biddings in the Prone pattern

Early East Frisian pulpit biddings after the medieval Prone: three biddings, then Decalogue,
confession, Creed and Our Father.

- **Earliest witness (archetype):** Norden 1528.
- **Tradition:** Reformed
  (an early East Frisian evangelical order, printed by Sehling among the Reformed orders of East Frisia).
- **Language:** Low Dutch.
- **Form:** biddings, then Decalogue, confession, Creed, Our Father.
- **Place in the service (Norden 1528):** Every Sunday after the sermon (“na dat sermoen”):
  three biddings, then the Ten Commandments, a confession of sins, the Creed with a confession
  of faith, and the Our Father.

| Year | Witness | Territory | Sehling | Form |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 1528 | Norden (East Frisia), Gottesdienstordnung [ca. 1528] (Reformed) | Norden, County of East Frisia | Sehling 7/1, IV/Ostfriesland Nr. 6, p. 431 | biddings + Decalogue + confession + Creed + Lord’s Prayer |

**Sequence:** M.1 Civil authority > M.2 Ministers of the Word > M.3 Enemies > M.4 Ten
Commandments.

#### <a id="s6-17-m-1"></a>M.1 Civil authority

**Rubric (Low Dutch).** Dese nabeschrevene manier wert geholden to Norden alle Sondaechs na dat
sermoen.

**Rubric (English).** This manner written hereafter is observed at Norden every Sunday after the
sermon.

**Bid (Low Dutch).** I. Laet ons aenroepen en bidden God, onsen hemelsken Vader, voor onse
gnädige here mit sinen rade en amptluyden en voor alle overheit der werelt, dat hoer God regere
en regeren laet na sine woerde en Geeste tot gemeinen welvaren en vrede.

**Bid (English).** I. Let us call upon and pray God, our heavenly Father, for our gracious lord
with his council and officers, and for all the magistracy of the world, that God would govern
them and let them govern according to his word and Spirit, unto the common welfare and peace.

#### <a id="s6-17-m-2"></a>M.2 Ministers of the Word

**Bid (Low Dutch).** II. Vor alle getrouwe dienaren en herderen der scapen Christi, dat se
vrymoedeliken en eendrachteliken Gods woert voeren en den gekruysten Christum verkondigen.

**Bid (English).** II. For all faithful ministers and shepherds of the sheep of Christ, that
they may set forth God’s word boldly and with one accord, and preach Christ crucified.

#### <a id="s6-17-m-3"></a>M.3 Enemies

**Bid (Low Dutch).** III. Item voer alle onse vyanden en alle ongelovigen: heiden, Joden, Turken
en valsche Christen, dat se God met sinen woerde en Geeste verlichte en hem goede herderen geve.
Laet ons onse krancheit en sonden bekennen, die ons ut Gods geset en geboden werden openbaert.

**Bid (English).** III. Item, for all our enemies and all unbelievers: heathen, Jews, Turks and
false Christians, that God would enlighten them with his word and Spirit and give them good
shepherds. Let us confess our weakness and sins, which are made manifest to us out of God’s law
and commandments.

#### <a id="s6-17-m-4"></a>M.4 Ten Commandments

**Rubric (Low Dutch).** Die tein geboden. … Ic gelove an God den Vader … Onse Vader in die
hemelen …

**Rubric (English).** The Ten Commandments. … I believe in God the Father … Our Father in the
heavens …

---

### <a id="s6-18"></a>6.18 Family R1: Heidelberg 1563 prayer

The Reformed Sunday prayer after the sermon: confession and absolution, a long continuous prayer
(fruit of the Word, ministers, magistrates, all men, the persecuted, the afflicted, the
congregation), then the Our Father. Copied in Moers, Bentheim-Tecklenburg, Ysenburg-Birstein
1598 and, abridged, Lutheran Schaumburg 1614.

- **Earliest witness (archetype):** Kurpfalz 1563 (Heidelberg).
- **Tradition:** Reformed (Schaumburg 1614 Lutheran).
- **Language:** German.
- **Form:** confession + absolution + continuous prayer + Our Father.
- **Place in the service (Kurpfalz 1563):** Sunday morning after the sermon: exhortation to
  confession, confession, absolution (with retention), then the prayer and the Our Father; a psalm
  and the Aaronic blessing follow. The prayer before the sermon is a separate confession of sins.

| Year | Witness | Territory | Sehling | Form |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 1563 | Kurpfalz, Kirchenordnung (Friedrich III.) (Reformed) | Electoral Palatinate | Sehling 14, Regierungszeit Friedrichs III. Nr. 60 (KO 1563), pp. 389–390 | confession + absolution + continuous prayer + Lord’s Prayer |
| 1581 | Moers, Kirchenordnung [1581] (Graf Adolf von Neuenahr) (Reformed) | County of Moers | Sehling 22, III/Moers Nr. 5 (KO [1581]), pp. 182–183 | continuous prayer + Lord’s Prayer |
| 1588 | Bentheim-Tecklenburg, Kirchenordnung 1588/1619 (Reformed) | Counties of Bentheim, Tecklenburg and Steinfurt | Sehling 22, IV/3, pp. 256–257 | continuous prayer + Lord’s Prayer |
| 1598 | Ysenburg-Birstein, Kirchenordnung 1598 (Graf Wolfgang Ernst) (Reformed) | County of Ysenburg-Büdingen-Birstein | Sehling 10, III/Ysenburg-Birstein Nr. 17, pp. 664–666 | confession + absolution + continuous prayer + Lord’s Prayer |
| 1614 | Schaumburg, Kirchenordnung 1614 (Graf/Fürst Ernst) (Lutheran) | County of Holstein-Schaumburg | Sehling 7/2.2, I/21, pp. 147–149 | confession + absolution + continuous prayer |

Schaumburg 1614 is a Lutheran order that takes over the Heidelberg confession, absolution and
prayer, abridged.

**Not in the representative text** (a minority reading of its category; see the Prayers sheet or
the critical sheets): Schaumburg 1614 no. 7 (Fruits of the earth).

**Sequence:** R1.1 Confession of sins > R1.2 Confession of sins > R1.3 Thanksgiving > R1.4 The
Word & its fruit > R1.5 Civil authority > R1.6 Fruits of the earth > R1.7 All men > R1.8 The
persecuted > R1.9 The afflicted > R1.10 Lord's Prayer.

#### <a id="s6-18-r1-1"></a>R1.1 Confession of sins

*Witnesses:* Kurpfalz 1563, Ysenburg-Birstein 1598 and Schaumburg 1614.

**Rubric (German).** Am Sontag nach der morgenpredig soll der kirchendiener sprechen:

**Rubric (English).** On Sunday after the morning sermon the minister shall say:

**Bid (German).** Ir geliebten in dem herrn, Dieweil wir in den geboten Gottes gleich als in
einem spiegel sehen, wie groß und vielfältig unser sünden sind, durch welche wir zeitliche und
ewige straf verdienen, so laßt uns diesselbige von hertzen unserm getreuen vater bekennen,
sprecht derhalben mit mir also:

**Bid (English).** Dearly beloved in the Lord, forasmuch as we see in the commandments of God as
in a glass how great and manifold our sins are, whereby we deserve temporal and eternal
punishment, let us confess the same from the heart unto our faithful Father; say therefore with
me thus:

**Prayer (German).** Ich armer sünder bekenn für dir, meinem Gott und schöpfer, daß ich leider
schwerlich und mannigfältig wider dich gesündiget hab, nicht allein mit eusserlichen groben
sünden, sonder vilmehr mit innerlicher angeborner blindheyt, unglauben, zweifelung,
kleinmütigkeyt, ungedult, hoffart, bösem geitz, heimlichen neid, haß und mißvergunst, auch
andern bösen dücken, wie du, mein herr und Gott, an mir erkennest und ich leider nit gnugsam
erkennen kan, die reuen mich und sind mir leid und beger von hertzen gnad, durch deinen lieben
son Jesum Christum.

**Prayer (English).** I, poor sinner, confess before thee, my God and Creator, that I, alas,
have sinned grievously and manifoldly against thee, not only with outward gross sins, but much
more with inward, inborn blindness, unbelief, doubting, faintheartedness, impatience, pride,
evil covetousness, secret envy, hatred and grudging, and other evil wiles, as thou, my Lord and
God, knowest in me, and I, alas, cannot sufficiently know; they repent me and grieve me, and I
desire grace from my heart, through thy dear Son Jesus Christ.

#### <a id="s6-18-r1-2"></a>R1.2 Confession of sins

*Witnesses:* Kurpfalz 1563, Ysenburg-Birstein 1598 and Schaumburg 1614. *Schaumburg 1614 lacks
the rubric.*

**Rubric (German).** Darauf soll er den gläubigen die vergebung der sünden und den unbußfertigen
das urtheil Gottes verkündigen und also sprechen:

**Rubric (English).** Thereupon he shall declare unto the faithful the forgiveness of sins, and
unto the impenitent the judgement of God, and say thus:

**Prayer (German).** Nun höret an den gewissen trost der gnaden Gottes, welche er allen
gläubigen in seinem evangelio verheisset. Also spricht der herr Christus Johan. am 3.: Also hat
Gott die welt geliebt, daß er seinen eingebornen son gab, auf daß alle, die an in glauben, nicht
verlorn werden, sonder das ewig leben haben. Sovil nun euer sein, die an ihnen selbst und an
iren sünden ein mißfallen haben und vertrauen, daß sie inen durch den verdienst Jesu Christi
allein gantz und gar vergeben sind, und den fürsatz haben, je lenger je mehr von sünden
abzustehen und dem herrn in warer heiligkeyt und gerechtigkeyt zu dienen, denselbigen (dieweil
sie glauben in den son des lebendigen Gottes) verkündige ich aus dem befelch Gottes, daß sie von
allen iren sünden (wie er in seinem heiligen evangelio verheißt) in dem himmel entbunden seind
durch die volkommene genugthuung des allerheiligisten leidens und sterbens unsers herrn Jesu
Christi, Amen. Soviel aber under euch seind, die noch einen gefallen haben an iren sünden und
schanden oder in sünden wider ir gewissen beharren, denselbigen verkündige ich auß befelch
Gottes, daß der zorn und das urtheil Gottes uber inen bleibt und daß alle ire sünden im himmel
gehalten seind und sie von der ewigen verdamnuß nit entbunden mögen werden, biß daß sie sich
bekehren.

**Prayer (English).** Hear now the sure comfort of the grace of God, which he promiseth in his
Gospel to all believers. Thus saith the Lord Christ in John the third: God so loved the world,
that he gave his only begotten Son, that whosoever believeth in him should not perish, but have
everlasting life. As many of you therefore as are displeased with yourselves and your sins, and
trust that they are wholly and altogether forgiven them through the merit of Jesus Christ alone,
and have the purpose more and more to cease from sins and to serve the Lord in true holiness and
righteousness, unto them (forasmuch as they believe in the Son of the living God) I declare by
the commandment of God that they are loosed in heaven from all their sins (as he promiseth in
his holy Gospel) through the perfect satisfaction of the most holy suffering and death of our
Lord Jesus Christ. Amen. But as many among you as yet have pleasure in their sins and shame, or
continue in sins against their conscience, unto them I declare by the commandment of God that
the wrath and judgement of God abideth upon them, and that all their sins are retained in
heaven, and that they cannot be loosed from eternal damnation until they be converted.

#### <a id="s6-18-r1-3"></a>R1.3 Thanksgiving

*Witnesses:* Kurpfalz 1563, Moers 1581, Bentheim-Tecklenburg 1588, Ysenburg-Birstein 1598 and
Schaumburg 1614. *Ysenburg-Birstein 1598 lacks the rubric.* *Moers 1581 and Bentheim-Tecklenburg
1588 lack the bid.*

**Rubric (German).** Gebet am Sontag nach der predigt und Absolution.

**Rubric (English).** Prayer on Sunday after the sermon and absolution.

**Bid (German).** Nachdem wir nun nicht zweifelen, wir und unser gebet seien durch das leiden
Jesu Christi geheiliget und Gott angenem, so laßt uns in von hertzen anrüfen und also sprechen:

**Bid (English).** Forasmuch now as we doubt not that we and our prayer are sanctified through
the suffering of Jesus Christ and acceptable unto God, let us call upon him from the heart and
say thus:

**Prayer (German).** Almechtiger Gott, schöpfer himmels und der erden, wir dancken dir auß grund
unsers hertzens, daß du uns erschaffen, biß auf disen tag uns und unsere kinder erhalten,
gespeiset und erneret hast und noch hinfort erhalten und regieren wilst. Insonderheyt aber
dancken wir dir, daß du deinen son Jesum Christum, den du im paradeiß verheissen hast, uns hast
zu erkennen geben und unsere sünden durch sein bitter leiden und sterben uns verzihen.

**Prayer (English).** Almighty God, Creator of heaven and of earth, we give thee thanks from the
ground of our heart that thou hast created us, and unto this day hast preserved, fed and
nourished us and our children, and wilt yet henceforth preserve and govern us. But especially we
give thee thanks that thou hast given us to know thy Son Jesus Christ, whom thou didst promise
in Paradise, and hast forgiven us our sins through his bitter suffering and death.

#### <a id="s6-18-r1-4"></a>R1.4 The Word & its fruit

*Witnesses:* Kurpfalz 1563, Moers 1581, Bentheim-Tecklenburg 1588 and Ysenburg-Birstein 1598.

**Prayer (German).** Und bitten dich, daß du uns zum ebenbildt deines sohns Jesu Christi durch
die predig deines worts und kraft deines heiligen geistes erneuern wöllest, auf daß wir mit leib
und seel ewig mit dir leben und dich preisen, darzu wir anfenglich erschaffen seind, und wöllest
dem satan weren, daß er uns dein heiliges wort nicht auß unsern hertzen reisse, wie er unsern
ersten eltern Adam und Even gethon hat.

**Prayer (English).** And we beseech thee that thou wouldest renew us unto the image of thy Son
Jesus Christ through the preaching of thy word and the power of thy Holy Spirit, that we may
live with thee eternally in body and soul and praise thee, whereunto we were created in the
beginning; and that thou wouldest withstand Satan, that he snatch not thy holy word out of our
hearts, as he did to our first parents Adam and Eve.

#### <a id="s6-18-r1-5"></a>R1.5 Civil authority

*Witnesses:* Kurpfalz 1563, Moers 1581, Bentheim-Tecklenburg 1588, Ysenburg-Birstein 1598 and
Schaumburg 1614.

**Prayer (German).** Dieweil du uns auch in diesem leben durch die handt unser oberkeyt, deiner
diener, wilst regieren, so bitten wir dich, der du ihre hertzen in deiner hand hast, wöllest
ihnen allen, der keyserlichen und königlichen majestat, allen fürsten und herrn, insonderheyt
unserm gnedigisten chur- und landsfürsten, hertzog Friderichen, pfaltzgraven, sampt irer
churfürstlichen gnaden ehegemahel, jungen herrschaft, rähten und amptleuten (auch einen erbern
rath dieser statt oder einer erbaren gemein dieses orts) gnad und einigkeyt verleihen, daß sie
ire gantze regierung dahin richten, daß unser herr Jesus Christus, dem du allen gewalt im himmel
und auf erden gegeben hast, uber sie und ire underthonen hersche, auf daß das arme volck, die da
sind creaturn deiner hend und schaf deiner wayde, für die auch der herr Jesus sein blut
vergossen hat, regiert werden in aller heiligkeyt und gerechtigkeyt, daß auch wir umb
deinetwillen inen alle gebürliche ehr und treu erzeigen und under inen ein ehrbar, fridsams und
christlichs leben füren mögen.

**Prayer (English).** And forasmuch as thou wilt govern us in this life also by the hand of our
magistrates, thy ministers, we beseech thee, who hast their hearts in thy hand, that thou
wouldest vouchsafe unto them all, the Imperial and royal Majesty, all princes and lords,
especially our most gracious Elector and prince of this land, Duke Frederick, Count Palatine,
together with his Electoral Grace’s consort, the young lordship, counsellors and officers (and
also an honourable council of this city, or an honourable commune of this place), grace and
unity, that they may direct their whole government to this end, that our Lord Jesus Christ, unto
whom thou hast given all power in heaven and in earth, may reign over them and their subjects;
that the poor people, which are the creatures of thy hands and the sheep of thy pasture, for
whom also the Lord Jesus hath shed his blood, may be governed in all holiness and righteousness;
and that we also for thy sake may show them all due honour and faithfulness, and lead under them
an honest, peaceable and Christian life.

#### <a id="s6-18-r1-6"></a>R1.6 Fruits of the earth

*Witnesses:* Kurpfalz 1563, Moers 1581, Bentheim-Tecklenburg 1588 and Ysenburg-Birstein 1598.

**Prayer (German).** Gib auch deinen segen und benedeiung zu der frucht der erden, auf daß wir
dich dardurch als einen vater und ursprung aller barmhertzigkeyt und güter erkennen.

**Prayer (English).** Give also thy blessing and benediction to the fruit of the earth, that we
may thereby acknowledge thee as a Father and fountain of all mercy and good things.

#### <a id="s6-18-r1-7"></a>R1.7 All men

*Witnesses:* Kurpfalz 1563, Moers 1581, Bentheim-Tecklenburg 1588, Ysenburg-Birstein 1598 and
Schaumburg 1614.

**Prayer (German).** Wir bitten dich auch nicht allein für uns, sonder auch für alle menschen
der gantzen welt, wöllest dich uber sie allesampt gnediglich erbarmen,

**Prayer (English).** We pray thee also not for ourselves only, but also for all men of the
whole world, that thou wouldest have mercy upon them all graciously;

#### <a id="s6-18-r1-8"></a>R1.8 The persecuted

*Witnesses:* Kurpfalz 1563, Moers 1581, Bentheim-Tecklenburg 1588 and Ysenburg-Birstein 1598.

**Prayer (German).** insonderheyt aber, die unser mitglieder seind an dem leib Jesu Christi und
umb deiner warheyt willen vom Türcken und bapst verfolgen leiden. Wöllest, o vater aller gnaden,
solches wüten deiner feind, die deinen son Jesum Christum in seinen gliedern verfolgen,
zurückhalten und die verfolgten mit unüberwindtlicher standhaftigkeyt und kraft deines heiligen
geists stercken, auf daß sie solche verfolgung von deiner hand mit dancksagung annemen und in
ihrem trübsal solche freund empfinden, welche ubertrifft allen verstand.

**Prayer (English).** but especially upon them that are our fellow members in the body of Jesus
Christ and for thy truth’s sake suffer persecution from the Turk and the Pope. Restrain, O
Father of all grace, such raging of thine enemies, which persecute thy Son Jesus in his members,
and strengthen the persecuted with invincible steadfastness and the power of thy Holy Spirit,
that they may receive such persecution from thy hand with thanksgiving, and in their tribulation
feel such joy as passeth all understanding.

#### <a id="s6-18-r1-9"></a>R1.9 The afflicted

*Witnesses:* Kurpfalz 1563, Moers 1581, Bentheim-Tecklenburg 1588, Ysenburg-Birstein 1598 and
Schaumburg 1614.

**Prayer (German).** Tröste und stercke alle armen, gefangen, krancken, witwen und weysen,
schwangere weiber und bekümmerte und angefochtene hertzen und gib ihnen deinen frieden,

**Prayer (English).** Comfort and strengthen all the poor, the captives, the sick, widows and
orphans, women with child, and troubled and tempted hearts, and give them thy peace;

#### <a id="s6-18-r1-10"></a>R1.10 Lord's Prayer

*Witnesses:* Kurpfalz 1563, Moers 1581, Bentheim-Tecklenburg 1588 and Ysenburg-Birstein 1598.

**Prayer (German).** durch unsern lieben herrn Jesum Christum, welcher uns diese gwisse
verheissung gethan hat: Fürwar, fürwar, sage ich euch, was ihr den vater bitten werdet in meinem
namen, das wirdt er euch geben, und uns darauf hat befohlen, also zu beten: Unser vater etc.

**Prayer (English).** through our dear Lord Jesus Christ, who hath made us this sure promise:
Verily, verily, I say unto you, Whatsoever ye shall ask the Father in my name, he will give it
you; and hath commanded us thereupon to pray thus: Our Father, etc.

---

### <a id="s6-19"></a>6.19 Family R2: Heidelberg Lord’s-Prayer paraphrase

The Heidelberg alternative prayer paraphrasing the Lord's Prayer clause by clause (after Geneva
and the Heidelberg Catechism qq. 122-127).

- **Earliest witness (archetype):** Kurpfalz 1563, alternative.
- **Tradition:** Reformed.
- **Language:** German.
- **Form:** Lord's Prayer paraphrase.
- **Place in the service (Kurpfalz 1563):** Alternative (“Oder also”) to the Sunday prayer after
  the sermon (after confession and absolution); followed by the Our Father, a psalm and the
  blessing.

| Year | Witness | Territory | Sehling | Form |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 1563 | Kurpfalz, Kirchenordnung (Friedrich III.) (Reformed) | Electoral Palatinate | Sehling 14, Regierungszeit Friedrichs III. Nr. 60 (KO 1563), pp. 390–391 | Lord’s Prayer paraphrase |
| 1588 | Bentheim-Tecklenburg, Kirchenordnung 1588/1619 (Reformed) | Counties of Bentheim, Tecklenburg and Steinfurt | Sehling 22, IV/3, pp. 256–258 | Lord’s Prayer paraphrase + Creed |

Each rubric is the clause of the Lord's Prayer that the paragraph expounds. Sehling prints the
clauses in square brackets in Kurpfalz 1563. Bentheim-Tecklenburg 1588 adds R2.9.

**Sequence:** R2.1 Exhortation / preface > R2.2 The Word & its fruit > R2.3 The Church > R2.4
All estates / households > R2.5 Fruits of the earth > R2.6 Repentance & forgiveness > R2.7 The
present congregation > R2.8 Conclusion > R2.9 Creed.

#### <a id="s6-19-r2-1"></a>R2.1 Exhortation / preface

*Witnesses:* Kurpfalz 1563 and Bentheim-Tecklenburg 1588.

**Rubric (German).** Oder also:

**Rubric (English).** Or thus:

**Prayer (German).** Almechtiger Gott, himlischer vater, der du hast uns verheissen, was wir
dich in dem namen deines geliebten sohns Jesu Christi werden bitten, das wöllest du uns
gewißlich geben.

**Prayer (English).** Almighty God, heavenly Father, who hast promised us that whatsoever we
shall ask thee in the name of thy beloved Son Jesus Christ, thou wilt surely give it us:

#### <a id="s6-19-r2-2"></a>R2.2 The Word & its fruit

*Witnesses:* Kurpfalz 1563 and Bentheim-Tecklenburg 1588. *The rubric is in Kurpfalz 1563 only.*

**Rubric (German).** Geheiliget werde dein nam.

**Rubric (English).** Hallowed be thy name.

**Prayer (German).** Wir bitten dich, daß du durch deinen heiligen geist in uns wöllest würcken,
daß wir dich recht erkennen und dich in allen deinen wercken, in welchen leuchtet dein
allmechtigkeyt, weißheyt, güte, gerechtigkeyt, barmhertzigkeyt und warheyt, heiligen, rühmen und
preisen und daß auch wir unser gantzes leben, gedancken, wort und werck dahin richten, daß dein
nam umb unsertwillen nicht gelestert, sonder geehret und gepriesen werde.

**Prayer (English).** We beseech thee that thou wouldest work in us by thy Holy Spirit, that we
may rightly know thee, and hallow, extol and praise thee in all thy works, wherein shineth thine
almightiness, wisdom, goodness, righteousness, mercy and truth; and that we also may so direct
our whole life, thoughts, words and works, that thy name be not blasphemed for our sakes, but
honoured and praised.

#### <a id="s6-19-r2-3"></a>R2.3 The Church

*Witnesses:* Kurpfalz 1563 and Bentheim-Tecklenburg 1588. *The rubric is in Kurpfalz 1563 only.*

**Rubric (German).** Dein reich kom.

**Rubric (English).** Thy kingdom come.

**Prayer (German).** Auch regier uns also durch das scepter deines worts und kraft deines
heiligen geistes, daß wir und alle menschen uns deiner majestet von tag zu tag mehr underwerfen
und ergeben, erhalt und mehre deine kirch und zerstör alle werck des teufels und alle falsche
und böse rahtschläg, die wider dein heiliges wort erdacht werden. Mach zuschanden deine feind
durch die macht deiner warheyt und gerechtigkeyt, daß also aller gewalt, der sich wider deine
ehr erhebet, von tag zu tag mehr zerstöret und vertilget werde, biß die vollkommenheyt deines
reichs herzukomme, wenn du am jüngsten gericht deine herrligkeyt in uns offenbaren und in
ewigkeyt alles in allen sein wirst.

**Prayer (English).** Rule us also so by the sceptre of thy word and the power of thy Holy
Spirit, that we and all men may from day to day submit and yield ourselves more unto thy
Majesty; preserve and increase thy Church, and destroy all the works of the devil and all false
and wicked counsels devised against thy holy word. Confound thine enemies by the might of thy
truth and righteousness, that so all power which exalteth itself against thine honour may from
day to day be more destroyed and brought to nought, until the perfection of thy kingdom come,
when thou shalt reveal thy glory in us at the last judgement and be all in all for ever.

#### <a id="s6-19-r2-4"></a>R2.4 All estates / households

*Witnesses:* Kurpfalz 1563 and Bentheim-Tecklenburg 1588. *The rubric is in Kurpfalz 1563 only.*

**Rubric (German).** Dein will geschehe etc.

**Rubric (English).** Thy will be done, etc.

**Prayer (German).** Verleihe auch, daß wir und alle menschen unserem eignen willen und allen
lüsten unsers fleischs absagen und deinem allein guten willen one alles widersprechen gehorchen,
daß also jederman sein ampt und beruf so willig und treulich verrichte wie die engel im himmel.

**Prayer (English).** Grant also that we and all men may renounce our own will and all the lusts
of our flesh, and obey thy will, which alone is good, without any gainsaying; that so every man
may perform his office and calling as willingly and faithfully as the angels in heaven.

#### <a id="s6-19-r2-5"></a>R2.5 Fruits of the earth

*Witnesses:* Kurpfalz 1563 and Bentheim-Tecklenburg 1588. *The rubric is in Kurpfalz 1563 only.*

**Rubric (German).** Gib uns heut unser teglich brodt.

**Rubric (English).** Give us this day our daily bread.

**Prayer (German).** Wöllest uns auch mit aller leiblichen notturft versorgen, uns fried und gut
regiment verleihen, auf daß wir dardurch erkennen, daß du der einige ursprung alles guten bist
und ein getreuer vater, der da sorget für seine kinder, daß auch on deinen segen weder unser
sorgen und arbeit noch deine gaben uns gedeien mögen und wir derhalben unser vertrauen von allen
creaturen abziehen und allein auf dich setzen.

**Prayer (English).** Provide us also with all bodily necessaries, and vouchsafe us peace and
good government, that we may thereby acknowledge that thou art the only fountain of all good and
a faithful Father who careth for his children, and that without thy blessing neither our care
and labour nor thy gifts can prosper us; and that we may therefore withdraw our trust from all
creatures and set it upon thee alone.

#### <a id="s6-19-r2-6"></a>R2.6 Repentance & forgiveness

*Witnesses:* Kurpfalz 1563 and Bentheim-Tecklenburg 1588. *The rubric is in Kurpfalz 1563 only.*

**Rubric (German).** Vergib uns unser schuldt etc.

**Rubric (English).** Forgive us our debts, etc.

**Prayer (German).** Wollest auch uns armen sünderen alle unsere missethat und schulden, auch
das böß, so uns noch immerdar anhanget, umb des blutvergiessens Jesu Christi willen nicht
zurechnen, wie auch wir diß zeugnuß deiner gnaden in unsern hertzen befinden, daß wir unserm
nechsten von hertzen verzeihen und sein nutz begeren zu befürdern.

**Prayer (English).** Impute not unto us poor sinners all our misdeeds and debts, nor the evil
that yet always cleaveth unto us, for the sake of the shedding of the blood of Jesus Christ;
even as we also find this witness of thy grace in our hearts, that we forgive our neighbour from
the heart and desire to further his good.

#### <a id="s6-19-r2-7"></a>R2.7 The present congregation

*Witnesses:* Kurpfalz 1563 and Bentheim-Tecklenburg 1588. *The rubric is in Kurpfalz 1563 only.*

**Rubric (German).** Füre unß nit in versuchung etc.

**Rubric (English).** Lead us not into temptation, etc.

**Prayer (German).** Und dieweil wir ja auß uns selbst so schwach sein, daß wir nicht einen
augenblick bestehen können und darzu unsere abgesagte feind, der teufel, die welt und unser
eigen fleisch, nit aufhören, uns anzufechten, so wöllest uns erhalten und stercken durch die
kraft deines heiligen geistes, auf daß wir inen mögen festen widerstandt thuen und in diesem
geistlichen streit nit underligen, sonder bestendig bleiben, biß daß wir endtlich den sieg
vollkomlich erhalten und in deinem reich mit deinem son, unserm herrn und beschirmer Jesu
Christo, ewig regieren.

**Prayer (English).** And forasmuch as we of ourselves are so weak that we cannot stand one
moment, and moreover our sworn enemies, the devil, the world and our own flesh, cease not to
assail us: uphold and strengthen us by the power of thy Holy Spirit, that we may make firm
resistance against them and not be overcome in this spiritual warfare, but abide steadfast,
until at the last we obtain the victory perfectly and reign for ever in thy kingdom with thy
Son, our Lord and protector Jesus Christ.

#### <a id="s6-19-r2-8"></a>R2.8 Conclusion

*Witnesses:* Kurpfalz 1563 and Bentheim-Tecklenburg 1588.

**Prayer (German).** Welches alles wir von dir bitten, daß dadurch nit wir, sonder du ewig
gepriesen werdest, und daß du solches thun kanst als ein almechtiger Gott und thun wilst wie ein
getreuer vater, so gwiß als wir dises von hertzen an dich begeren, durch unsern herrn Jesum
Christum, Amen. Unser vater etc.

**Prayer (English).** All which we ask of thee, that thereby not we but thou mayest be praised
for ever; and that thou canst do this as an almighty God, and wilt do it as a faithful Father,
as surely as we desire this of thee from the heart; through our Lord Jesus Christ. Amen. Our
Father, etc.

#### <a id="s6-19-r2-9"></a>R2.9 Creed

*Witnesses:* Bentheim-Tecklenburg 1588.

**Prayer (German).** Wollest uns auch geben standthafftigkeit und täglichs zunemen in dem alten,
waren und ungezweiffelten Christlichen Glauben, auff daß wir uns durch denselben je lenger, je
mehr Christi Jesu und aller seiner Güter theilhafftig machen, von welchem Glauben wir bekantnuß
thun, mit Munde und Hertzen sprechende: Ich glaub in Gott Vatter, Almächtigen, etc.

**Prayer (English).** Give us also steadfastness and daily increase in the old, true and
undoubted Christian faith, that thereby we may make ourselves more and more partakers of Christ
Jesus and all his benefits; of which faith we make confession with mouth and heart, saying: I
believe in God the Father Almighty, etc.

---

### <a id="s6-20"></a>6.20 Family R3: Calvin’s “grande prière” (Strasbourg/Geneva)

Calvin's Strasbourg/Geneva "grande prière" in Latin, for the French refugee church, ending in a
paraphrase of the Lord's Prayer.

- **Earliest witness (archetype):** Frankfurt 1554 (Poullain).
- **Tradition:** Reformed.
- **Language:** Latin.
- **Form:** continuous prayer ending in a Lord's Prayer paraphrase.
- **Place in the service (Frankfurt 1554 (Poullain)):** Sunday morning: after the hour-long
  sermon and the announcements (betrothals, baptisms, the poor and sick who commend themselves to
  the prayers of the Church), while deacons collect alms at the door; followed immediately by the
  Creed, a psalm and the Aaronic blessing.

| Year | Witness | Territory | Sehling | Form |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 1554 | Frankfurt, Liturgia sacra of the stranger congregation (Valérand Poullain) (Reformed) | Frankfurt am Main: French/Walloon refugee church | Sehling 9, VI/Frankfurt Nr. 14, pp. 563–566 | continuous prayer with Lord’s-Prayer paraphrase |

The words between asterisks in R3.8 are said only when the Supper is celebrated.

**Sequence:** R3.1 Special intercessions > R3.2 Exhortation / preface > R3.3 Civil authority >
R3.4 Ministers of the Word > R3.5 All men > R3.6 The afflicted > R3.7 The persecuted > R3.8 The
present congregation > R3.9 Lord's Prayer > R3.10 Creed.

#### <a id="s6-20-r3-1"></a>R3.1 Special intercessions

**Rubric (Latin).** Concionem horae spatio absolvit ac subiecta precatione concludit. Admonet
autem prius Ecclesiam, si qua sunt digna aut necessaria, Nempe si sponsalia sint, si baptismus,
si quis pauper aut aegrotus se commendat precibus ecclesiae et caetera eiusmodi. Interea diaconi
duo ad ostium a singulis eleemosynam postulant in pauperum usus.

**Rubric (English).** He endeth the sermon within the space of an hour and concludeth it with
the prayer subjoined. But first he admonisheth the Church of aught that is worthy or needful:
as, if there be betrothals, if a baptism, if any poor or sick man commend himself to the prayers
of the Church, and other things of the kind. Meanwhile two deacons at the door ask alms of every
one for the use of the poor.

#### <a id="s6-20-r3-2"></a>R3.2 Exhortation / preface

**Rubric (Latin).** Oratio

**Rubric (English).** Prayer

**Prayer (Latin).** Deus omnipotens Pater coelestis, tu quidem promisisti exaudire vota nostra,
quacunque de re te appellaverimus in nomine dilecti filii tui Iesu Christi Domini nostri. Nos
quoque ille sic docuit sanctos coetus inter nos habere in nomine suo, promissis liberalibus
etiam invitans, quod his coetibus nostris adfuturus sit medius, quo uno mediatore et
intercessore abs te impetremus, quicquid unanimes petierimus super terram. In primis autem iubes
nos orare pro omnibus, quoscunque in potestate supra nos esse voluisti, ac deinceps pro iis
rebus, quae ad usus necessarios populi tui atque omnium hominum pertinent. Cui mandato tuo
obtemperantes sola fiducia sanctissimi instituti tui ac promissorum tuorum freti huc coram te
convenimus in nomen Christi filii tui Domini nostri rogantes ex animo supplices, o Deus idemque
Pater optime, in nomine liberatoris unici eiusdemque mediatoris nostri, liberaliter nobis pro
tua clementia condones omnia peccata nostraque corda, mentes, cogitatus ac vota omnia sic ad te
flectas et pertrahas, qui valeamus te invocare vera et simplici oratione, quae tibi grata sit et
accepta.

**Prayer (English).** Almighty God, heavenly Father, thou hast promised to hear our petitions,
in whatsoever thing we call upon thee in the name of thy beloved Son Jesus Christ our Lord. He
also hath so taught us to hold holy assemblies among us in his name, inviting us moreover with
bountiful promises, that he will be in the midst of these our assemblies, that by him our only
Mediator and Intercessor we may obtain of thee whatsoever we shall ask with one accord upon
earth. And first of all thou commandest us to pray for all whom thou hast willed to be in
authority over us, and thereafter for those things that pertain to the needful uses of thy
people and of all men. Obeying this thy commandment, and trusting only in thy most holy
ordinance and thy promises, we are come together here before thee in the name of Christ thy Son
our Lord, humbly beseeching thee from the heart, O God and most good Father, in the name of our
only Deliverer and Mediator, that of thy clemency thou wouldest freely pardon us all our sins,
and so bend and draw unto thee our hearts, minds, thoughts and all our desires, that we may be
able to call upon thee with true and single prayer, which may be pleasing and acceptable unto
thee.

#### <a id="s6-20-r3-3"></a>R3.3 Civil authority

**Prayer (Latin).** Oramus itaque tuam clementiam, o Pater coelestis, pro principibus et
hominibus cunctis potestatem gerentibus servis tuis, quibus abs te mandatum est ius dicere
populo tuo, nominatim vero pro consulibus et senatu huius civitatis, ut ipsis largiri digneris
spiritum tuum, qui vere princeps est et voluntatum moderator, eiusque dona, vim et gratiam in
dies magis magisque adaugeas, quo simul vere agnoscant unum ac solum Christum filium tuum
Dominum nostrum Regem regum ac principatum tenentem supra omnem potestatem, cui nempe abs te
data sit potestas omnis in coelo et in terra, tum certa fide persuasi totis animis studeant vero
ac spirituali cultu sese illi approbare regnumque ipsius apud subditos suos provehere et
amplificare, quos etiam regant iuxta praescriptum voluntatis tuae ex lege tua, sicuti certo
norunt se et illos abs te factos et conditos adeoque oves esse tuorum armentorum, liceat itaque
tuo beneficio pace frui, in qua tibi serviamus cum omni sanctitate et honestate liberatique ab
inimicis nostris tibi gratias et laudes persolvere queamus.

**Prayer (English).** We pray therefore thy clemency, O heavenly Father, for princes and all men
bearing authority, thy servants, to whom it is committed of thee to do justice to thy people,
and by name for the consuls and senate of this city: that thou wouldest vouchsafe to bestow upon
them thy Spirit, which is truly a princely Spirit and the governor of wills, and increase more
and more from day to day his gifts, power and grace; that they may truly acknowledge the one and
only Christ thy Son our Lord, the King of kings, holding the principality above all power, to
whom indeed all power in heaven and in earth hath been given of thee; and then, being persuaded
with sure faith, may study with all their hearts to approve themselves unto him with true and
spiritual worship, and to advance and enlarge his kingdom among their subjects, whom also they
may rule according to the prescript of thy will out of thy law, as they surely know that both
they and these are made and fashioned of thee, and are the sheep of thy flocks. May it be
granted us therefore by thy benefit to enjoy peace, wherein we may serve thee in all holiness
and honesty, and, being delivered from our enemies, may render thee thanks and praises.

#### <a id="s6-20-r3-4"></a>R3.4 Ministers of the Word

**Prayer (Latin).** Oramus etiam, Pater verax et liberator unice, pro iis, quos ecclesiae tuae
dedisti pastores et salutis animarum procurationem ac sacrosancti evangelii tui ministerium
commendasti; eos tuo spiritu sic regas et adiuves, ut sint fideles ministri gloriae tuae, huc
studia omnia conferentes, quo palabundus adhuc ovium tuarum grex in unum coeat ad Iesum Christum
verum ac summum pastorem principemque episcoporum, uti in eo et per eum in dies magis atque
magis crescant cum omni iustitia et sanctimonia vitae. Rursum dignare ecclesias omnes tuas
vindicare et eripere e luporum faucibus ac mercenariorum omnium unguibus, qui ambitioni suae
serviunt et compendii sui gratia faciunt omnia, nihil minus solliciti, quam ut sacratissimum
nomen tuum celebre ac sanctum ubique sit et grex tuus salutem consequatur.

**Prayer (English).** We pray also, O true Father and only Deliverer, for those whom thou hast
given as pastors to thy Church, and to whom thou hast committed the care of the salvation of
souls and the ministry of thy most holy Gospel: so govern and help them by thy Spirit, that they
may be faithful ministers of thy glory, bending all their endeavours to this, that the flock of
thy sheep, yet wandering, may gather together into one unto Jesus Christ, the true and chief
Shepherd and Prince of bishops, that in him and through him they may grow more and more from day
to day in all righteousness and holiness of life. Vouchsafe again to deliver all thy churches
and to snatch them out of the jaws of the wolves and the claws of all hirelings, which serve
their own ambition and do all things for their own gain, caring for nothing less than that thy
most holy name be everywhere renowned and holy, and thy flock attain unto salvation.

#### <a id="s6-20-r3-5"></a>R3.5 All men

**Prayer (Latin).** Insuper te rogamus, o Deus clementissime et Pater misericors, pro universo
hominum genere, ut qui velis agnosci ab omnibus toto orbe terrarum liberator unicus parta
redemptione per Christum filium tuum, digneris etiam, quotquot adhuc hodie ab eodem Christo
filio tuo longius absunt, vincti sedentes in tenebris et omni salutis ignoratione, spiritu tuo
illustratos per praedicationem evangelii in rectam salutis viam reducere, nempe ut agnoscant te
verum Deum et quem misisti Iesum Christum. Quos vero iam eo favore dignatus es, ut eorum
mentibus illucesceres manifestatione verbi tui, fac in dies omni bono ac benedictionis tuae
spiritualis abundantia auctiores ac beatiores evadant, quo tandem aliquando valeamus omnes
unanimi consensu vere et ex animo tuam maiestatem adorare et laudibus extollere ac denique nos
totos in clientelam tradere unigenito tuo, quem solum nos agnoscimus Dominum regem ac
legislatorem nostrum.

**Prayer (English).** Moreover we beseech thee, O most clement God and merciful Father, for the
whole race of men: that as thou wilt be acknowledged of all throughout the whole world as the
only Deliverer, redemption having been wrought through Christ thy Son, thou wouldest vouchsafe
also to bring back into the right way of salvation, enlightened by thy Spirit through the
preaching of the Gospel, all that are yet this day far off from the same Christ thy Son, sitting
bound in darkness and in all ignorance of salvation; that they may know thee the true God, and
Jesus Christ whom thou hast sent. And them whom thou hast already vouchsafed that favour, that
thou hast shone into their minds by the manifestation of thy word, make them from day to day to
grow richer and more blessed in all good and in the abundance of thy spiritual blessing; that at
the last we may all be able with one accord truly and from the heart to adore thy Majesty and
extol it with praises, and finally to deliver ourselves wholly into the keeping of thine
Only-begotten, whom alone we acknowledge as our Lord, King and Lawgiver.

#### <a id="s6-20-r3-6"></a>R3.6 The afflicted

**Prayer (Latin).** Ad haec eos tibi commendamus etiam, o Deus consolator, quos visitas, ut
castiges cruce vel quocunque afflictionis genere et populos, quos tu iam peste bellove aut fame
urges, singulos denique, quos aliqua per te premit inopia vel carcer aut morbus aut exilium aut
quaecunque tandem calamitas, seu corporis illa sit seu animi. Da, ut intelligant tuam erga illos
vere paternam benevolentiam, nempe quod ideo castiges et corrigas, ut emendati revertantur ad te
ex toto corde suo ac plenam consolationem reportent liberati ab omnibus malis.

**Prayer (English).** To these things we commend unto thee also, O God of comfort, those whom
thou visitest, that thou mayest chasten them with the cross or with any kind of affliction; and
the peoples whom thou now pressest with pestilence, war or famine; and lastly every one whom any
want sent by thee oppresseth, or prison, or sickness, or exile, or any calamity whatsoever, be
it of body or of mind. Grant that they may understand thy truly fatherly goodwill toward them,
namely that thou chastenest and correctest them to this end, that being amended they may return
unto thee with their whole heart, and, being delivered from all evils, may receive full
consolation.

#### <a id="s6-20-r3-7"></a>R3.7 The persecuted

**Prayer (Latin).** Unice vero tibi commendatos volumus fratres nostros electos tuos, quotquot
sub tyrannide Antichristi vivunt adhuc dispersi, pabulo vitae spiritualis destituti atque
libertate illa filiorum tuorum, ut publice possint nomen tuum invocare, in primis autem eos, qui
vincti sunt aut qualicunque modo opprimuntur apud hostes evangelii tui; digneris, o Pater
indulgentissime, robur spiritus tui in illis augere, quo firmiores sint nec unquam deficiant,
sed constanter perseverent in sancta vocatione tua. Velis illos tuo semper auxilio sustinere ac
fulcire, quantum opus esse nosti, simulque consolari in adversis omnibus tuaque cura tueri
adversus luporum rabiem, quo per ipsos nomen tuum illustrius fiat tam in vita quam in morte.

**Prayer (English).** But above all we would have commended unto thee our brethren, thine elect,
as many as yet live scattered under the tyranny of Antichrist, destitute of the food of
spiritual life and of that liberty of thy children, that they might publicly call upon thy name;
and first of all those that are in bonds or in any manner oppressed among the enemies of thy
Gospel. Vouchsafe, O most indulgent Father, to increase in them the strength of thy Spirit, that
they may be the firmer and never fail, but persevere constantly in thy holy calling. Be pleased
ever to uphold and stay them with thy help, so far as thou knowest to be needful, and withal to
comfort them in all adversities and defend them by thy care against the rage of the wolves, that
through them thy name may be made more glorious both in life and in death.

#### <a id="s6-20-r3-8"></a>R3.8 The present congregation

**Prayer (Latin).** Da denique, o Deus et Pater, nobis iam collectis in unum in nomine Iesu
Christi filii tui ad audiendum verbum evangelii \*et communicandum sacrosanctae ipsius coenae
mysteriis\*, ut vere agnoscamus serioque sentiamus, quam miseri simus ac perditi iam inde a
prima nostra origine, in dies magis atque magis iudicium tuum in nos provocantes vitae
improbitate, itaque ubi perspexerimus, quam nihil in nobis insit boni quodque nostra caro et
sanguis regni tui haereditatem consequi haudquaquam possint, tum animis totis nos ipsos dedamus
unice dilecto filio tuo Iesu Christo liberatori nostro unico, ut ita nos possideat et corda
nostra inhabitet, quo mortuo ac plane deleto veteri Adamo innovemur in vitae puritatem,

**Prayer (English).** Grant lastly, O God and Father, unto us that are now gathered together in
the name of Jesus Christ thy Son to hear the word of the Gospel \*and to communicate in the most
holy mysteries of his Supper\*, that we may truly acknowledge and earnestly feel how wretched
and lost we are even from our first origin, provoking thy judgement against us more and more
from day to day by the wickedness of our life; and so, when we have perceived how there is no
good in us, and that our flesh and blood can in no wise obtain the inheritance of thy kingdom,
we may give ourselves up with our whole hearts to thy only beloved Son Jesus Christ, our only
Deliverer, that he may so possess us and dwell in our hearts that, the old Adam being dead and
utterly done away, we may be renewed unto purity of life:

#### <a id="s6-20-r3-9"></a>R3.9 Lord's Prayer

**Rubric (Latin).** Paraphrasis dominicae orationis, 1.–6.

**Rubric (English).** Paraphrase of the Lord’s Prayer, 1–6

**Prayer (Latin).** 1. qua nomen tuum, uti par est, supra omnia ubique laudibus extollatur et
magnum fiat. 2. Simul etiam ius imperiumque obtineas, imo exerceas etiam in nos omnes, ut magis
magisque in dies condiscamus vera obedientia et digna reverentia tuam maiestatem venerari 3.
Tuque adeo solus ubique regnes omnium Dominus ac populum tuum sceptro verbi tui et virtute
spiritus tui regas et moderere omnesque, qui tibi adversantur, veritatis ac iustitiae tuae
potentia debellatos expugnes. Ita fiet, ut potestas omnis atque celsitudo, quae gloriae tuae
obluctatur, sensim destruatur funditusque evertatur, donec palam fiat regnum tuum, quod
videlicet tu solus rex sis et Dominus, qui ad iudicandum accessurus es. Nos quoque cum creaturis
universis tibi per omnia obtemperemus, sicuti novimus Angelos sanctos, qui tecum coelos
incolunt, nullum velle aliud habere, quam ut quicquid tibi gratum et placitum fuerit, statim
absque remora pro tuae voluntatis arbitrio perficiatur. Nos ita tibi quoque placere studeamus
neglectis ac posthabitis cunctis nostrae carnis desideriis et placitis. 4. Donec autem nos coram
te ambulamus cum amore et timore nominis tui, tu pro tua bonitate nutrias et pascas omnia
sufficiens, quae vitae huic sint necessaria, qui panem nostrum cum pace comedamus, qua tua cura
et sollicitudine nostri persuasissimum nobis sit te patrem esse, a quo uno expectanda sint
omnia, deposita omni fiducia nostri ac creaturarum omnium, ut in tua unius bonitate ac
benevolentia acquiescamus. 5. Quoniam vero, quandiu vita haec manet, nos miseri peccatores in
morte media versamur ac fragiles adeo sumus, ut perpetuo prolabamur impingentes ad omnia,
semperque aberrantes discedimus a recto, nobis hac in parte sic esto propitius, ut condones haec
delicta omnia, quibus iudicio tuo iustissimo nos fecimus obnoxios, eademque condonatione liberes
a morte aeterna, cui nostro merito addicti sumus. Ergo malum hoc, quod circumferimus, ne nobis
imputes, quemadmodum nos quoque tuo iussu iniuriarum obliviscimur ac vindictae loco bona omnia
nostris inimicis precamur. 6. In posterum denique nos tua virtute fulcias, ne rursum carnis
infirmitate prolapsi te offendamus. Cumque ea sit nostrarum virium imbecillitas, ut ne ad
momentum quidem temporis perstare valeamus atque adeo cincti undique crudelissimis hostibus
perpetuam impressionem patiamur a diabolo, mundo et carne, quibuscum nobis continuum est bellum,
nos tuo spiritu corrobora et gratiarum tuarum donis munias, ut possimus constanter perstare
adversus omne genus tentationis inque spirituali hac lucta sic pergere, ut tandem victoria plena
potiti triumphum agamus in regno tuo una cum duce et capite summoque et unico protectore nostro
Domino Iesu Christo, Amen.

**Prayer (English).** 1. whereby thy name, as is meet, may be extolled with praises above all
things everywhere and be made great. 2. That thou mayest also hold, yea, exercise thy right and
dominion over us all, that we may learn more and more from day to day to worship thy Majesty
with true obedience and due reverence; 3. and that thou alone mayest reign everywhere, the Lord
of all, and govern and rule thy people by the sceptre of thy word and the power of thy Spirit,
and overthrow all that oppose thee, vanquished by the might of thy truth and righteousness. So
shall it come to pass that all power and height that striveth against thy glory shall little by
little be destroyed and utterly overturned, until thy kingdom be made manifest, to wit, that
thou alone art King and Lord, who art to come to judgement. May we also with all creatures obey
thee in all things, as we know that the holy Angels, which dwell with thee in the heavens, will
have nothing else but that whatsoever is pleasing and acceptable unto thee be forthwith
performed without delay according to the pleasure of thy will; and may we so study to please
thee also, all the desires and pleasures of our flesh being neglected and set aside. 4. And so
long as we walk before thee with love and fear of thy name, do thou of thy goodness nourish and
feed us, supplying all things that be necessary for this life, that we may eat our bread in
peace, whereby through thy care and solicitude for us we may be most fully persuaded that thou
art the Father from whom alone all things are to be looked for, and, laying aside all trust in
ourselves and in all creatures, may rest in thy goodness and benevolence alone. 5. But forasmuch
as, so long as this life endureth, we miserable sinners are in the midst of death, and are so
frail that we continually slip and stumble at all things, and ever wandering depart from the
right: be thou in this behalf so propitious unto us, that thou pardon all these offences whereby
we have made ourselves liable to thy most just judgement, and by the same pardon deliver us from
eternal death, to which by our desert we are adjudged. Therefore impute not unto us this evil
that we carry about, even as we also by thy commandment forget injuries, and instead of revenge
pray for all good things for our enemies. 6. And finally, for the time to come uphold us by thy
power, lest, falling again through the infirmity of the flesh, we offend thee. And since such is
the weakness of our strength that we cannot stand firm even for a moment of time, and being
beset on every side with most cruel enemies we suffer continual assault from the devil, the
world and the flesh, with which we have perpetual war: strengthen us by thy Spirit and fortify
us with the gifts of thy graces, that we may stand constantly against every kind of temptation,
and so go on in this spiritual combat that at the last, having obtained full victory, we may
triumph in thy kingdom together with our Captain and Head and highest and only Protector, the
Lord Jesus Christ. Amen.

#### <a id="s6-20-r3-10"></a>R3.10 Creed

**Rubric (Latin).** Huic precationi immediate symbolum additur, quo recitato praecentor statim
psalmum incipit, cui deinde populus accinit ad finem usque, quo decantato pastor populum
dimittit hac bona imprecatione.

**Rubric (English).** To this prayer the Creed is immediately added; which being recited, the
precentor straightway beginneth a psalm, to which the people then sing to the end; which being
sung, the pastor dismisseth the people with this good wish.
